lines.en: Debbie Hart is going to swim across the English Channel tomorrow.
She is going to set out from the French coast at five o'clock in the morning.
lines.zh: 哈特准备明天横渡英吉利海峡。

lines.en: Debbie is only eleven years old and she hopes to set up a new world record.
lines.zh: 她打算早上5点钟从法国海岸出发。

lines.en: She is a strong swimmer and many people feel that she is sure to succeed.
lines.zh: 黛比只有11岁，她希望创一项新的世界纪录。

lines.en: Debbie's father will set out with her in a small boat.
lines.zh: 她是一个游泳能手，很多人认为她一定能成功。

lines.en: Mr.. Hart has trained his daughter for years.
lines.zh: 黛比的父亲将乘一条小船同她一道出发。

lines.en: Tomorrow he will be watching her anxiously as she swims the long distance to England.
lines.zh: 哈特先生训练她的女儿已经多年了，明天他将焦急地注视着女儿游过这段漫长的距离到达英国。

lines.en: Debbie intends to take short rests every two hours.
lines.zh: 黛比计划每两小时休息一下。

lines.en: She will have something to drink but she will not eat any solid food.
lines.zh: 她将喝些饮料，但不吃固体食物。

lines.en: Most of Debbie's school friends will be waiting for her on the English coast.
lines.zh: 黛比的大部分同学将在英国海岸等候她。

lines.en: Among them will be Debbie's mother, who swam the Channel herself when she was a girl.
lines.zh: 他们当中还会有黛比的母亲，她本人还是个姑娘时，也曾横渡过英吉利海峡！

question.en: What is Debbie going to try to do?

words.zh: 如果同一词音节落在第一个音节的重音，肯定是名词，重音落在第二个音节肯定是动词
be to/be about to/be going do: 表将来
连词连接两个句子，副词只能修饰句子或者动词，起修饰作用
